title: Write Compelling Stories with Our Complete Story Bundle
meta_description: Unlock your creativity with the How to Write a Story Bundle. Master storytelling techniques and craft compelling narratives with ease.
heading: How to Write a Story Bundle

messages: Story Shapes section explains how to create Story Graphs – an illustrated planning framework to help kids structure their stories
Easy-to-follow mark schemes for kids to practise assessing their own work

description.html:
Discover 33 more story kits, complete with illustrations, writing prompts, targeted questions for story planning, and curated vocabulary lists. This is writing, made easy! Whatever sparks your imagination, whether it's dystopian science fiction or reimagined fairy tales or eerie detective mysteries or intrepid space missions, you'll find inspiration here.

For ages 8-10 & 10-12
